QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] Toward the First Seal 1
QuestInfo.0: Time for you to pursue the Flora. Luce seems to know where to go.
QuestInfo.1: Luce says you need to break the three seals to find the treasure of Tallahart. However, the enemy has a head start. Follow Luce's directions to reach the first seal.
QuestInfo.2: Apparently the enemy has already reached the first seal. Pursue Veronica.
